items.title: Leslie Gourse interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: So he sat down with me with tapes, and we spoke on the phone after I would work on something I might read it to him on the phone, and then a couple of times we met face to face and I read to him and we went over it.

ctx.x: You have some nice quotes about — returning to Joe for a moment — did you find him an easy interview?

I was just going to say that. He was the most forthcoming guy. And he is brilliant. And he’s a hard worker, and he loves to work, and it was something different then, you know, to do this book. Well you can see for years he’d never sat down to do a book. So he sat down with me with tapes, and we spoke on the phone after I would work on something I might read it to him on the phone, and then a couple of times we met face to face and I read to him and we went over it. And I could read, you know because we had…
I guess that comes from his profession. His profession is he’s a professional listener.
